claim: A merged PR (#2476, 'feat(metrics): add ATOM as a built-in engine', merged Sep 11 2026) demonstrates the canonical process for adding a new inference-engine backend to the metrics extractor: the engine exposes queue depth/running count/KV-cache utilization/cache geometry under its own metric-name prefix (atom:), and is selected purely by labeling the Pod llm-d.ai/engine-type: atom, with no code change needed beyond registering the built-in spec strings.
stance_target: documented, working precedent for adding a new backend engine type to the EPP's metrics extraction layer
quoted_support: Registering it here means a deployment only has to label its pods with llm-d.ai/engine-type: atom, rather than carrying an engineConfigs block that restates metric names the engine already fixes.

claim: A dev-environment bugfix PR (#2426) confirms the token-producer / render-server data source can be pointed at a standalone Kubernetes Service address (vllm-render:8082) via a URL parameter (VLLM_RENDER_URL) rather than assuming a pod-local sidecar on localhost, showing at least one Data Layer producer is already addressed by URL, not hard-coded pod IP.
stance_target: evidence that some EPP data producers are already URL-addressable rather than pod-IP-bound
quoted_support: the kind dev env runs the vLLM render server as a separate Service (vllm-render:8082), not a sidecar ... Use VLLM_RENDER_URL (already exported, defaults to http://vllm-render:8082)

claim: llm-d Router supports two deployment topologies: Sidecar mode (proxy runs in the EPP pod, default, suited to basic testing) and Gateway mode (EPP is a backend for an InferencePool referenced by an HTTPRoute on a shared Gateway, recommended for production, enabling multi-cluster load balancing and shared infra).
stance_target: deployment-topology options that constrain how a customized router would be wired into a cluster
quoted_support: Sidecar mode (default): The proxy runs in the EPP pod. ... The recommended mode for production environments ... the EPP acts as a backend for an InferencePool, which is referenced by an HTTPRoute on a shared Gateway.
